question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

We are entering a point where technology will change at _________ speeds.
solution:
The correct answer is '**extreme**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The word "**extreme**" means reaching a high or the highest degree; very great. (अत्यधिक) 
 
• In the context of technology changing, "extreme speeds" implies a very rapid pace of change. 
 
• The other options are either misspelled or do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *We are entering a point where technology will change at extreme__ speeds.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Inferior (निम्न/घटिया)**: This is the correct spelling of the word meaning lower in rank, status, or quality. The spelling "inferier" is incorrect. 
 
• **Supreme (सर्वोच्च)**: This is the correct spelling of the word meaning highest in rank or authority; highest in degree or quality. The spelling "suprime" is incorrect. 
 
• **Moderate (मध्यम)**: This is the correct spelling of the word meaning average in amount, intensity, quality, or degree. The spelling "modarate" is incorrect. While it's a correctly spelled word, it doesn't fit the context of rapid technological change.
